6fdf61fe04.headline: Ramayana Part 1 opens with ₹127.5 Crore worldwide and ₹64.85 Crore net in India on Day 1
6fdf61fe04.caption:
Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash's #Ramayana Part 1 has grossed ₹127.5 crore worldwide on its opening day, November 5, as per trade reports. In India, the film collected ₹64.85 crore net (₹77.5 crore gross), according to Sacnilk.

Hindi led with ₹47.5 crore net, followed by Kannada at ₹7.25 crore, Telugu at ₹6 crore, Tamil at ₹2.6 crore and Malayalam at ₹1.5 crore, across 25,200 shows. With the Diwali weekend ahead, trade experts expect the numbers to climb further.
